prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny green meadow full of wildflowers with a dirt path, a wooden fence and gate of normal height, bright and backlit, shadows falling toward the camera, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, backlit by the low sun, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in an intricate fishtail braid, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long silver chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a tin ship's anchor, a gold hammer head, a gold miniature anvil), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked gold bracelets. RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a white ruffled lace maid headband, a black lace choker with a small bow and white lace wrist cuffs, a tiny black satin micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal black satin micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.

Background & Lighting: a bright rim of sunlight outlining every figure, each material catching the backlight in glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
